signals.entity: Central Bank of Montenegro (CBCG) + all 11 Montenegrin banks
signals.signal: CBCG put the national instant-payment system live on 20/07/2026 using TIPS Clone (a licensed copy of the Eurosystem's TARGET Instant Payment Settlement platform). Montenegro is the first country worldwide to bring TIPS Clone into operation, and did so with the ENTIRE banking sector - all 11 banks - live on day one. CBCG Council capped the fee for sending or receiving an instant payment up to EUR200 at 5 cents; above EUR200 the fee cannot exceed the bank's normal credit-transfer fee. Follows Montenegro's SEPA accession on 06/10/2025.
signals.source_name: Central Bank of Montenegro - Saopstenja (official press release)
signals.implies: A 24/7/365 real-time rail with a near-zero price cap will pull volume off cash and cards. Immediate second-wave needs at all 11 banks: 24/7 real-time fraud and transaction monitoring (instant payments are irrevocable - INETCO, FICO), ISO 20022 message handling and reconciliation, instant-payment acceptance at the point of sale and request-to-pay, and cash-forecasting re-baselining as ATM withdrawal patterns shift (NCR APTRA OptiCash). Printec is already present in ME's neighbours; this is the cleanest near-term regional opening.
signals.likelihood: High - the rail is live; the fraud-monitoring and POS-acceptance layers are the standard follow-on within 6-18 months
signals.followup: Track CBCG's 'Instant placanja (TIPS Clone)' page (cbcg.me/me/kljucne-funkcije/platni-promet/instant-placanja-tips-clone) for scheme rules and phase-2 (POS/request-to-pay); approach all 11 ME banks on instant-payment fraud monitoring and reconciliation.

signals.entity: Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina (CBBiH) + Intesa Sanpaolo Banka BiH, Raiffeisen Bank BiH, Sparkasse Bank BiH
signals.signal: CBBiH launched BiH's domestic instant-payment system (IPS BiH) on 20/07/2026, described by CBBiH as the single biggest modernisation of BiH payment infrastructure in 25 years; 24/7/365 credit transfers in seconds. Only three banks - Intesa Sanpaolo Banka BiH, Raiffeisen Bank BiH and Sparkasse Bank BiH - completed the technical adaptation and testing in time; together roughly one quarter of BiH banking-sector assets. CBBiH states the system is open to all commercial banks from day one and the remainder will join gradually as they complete technical/operational adaptation.
signals.source_name: CBBiH - Instant platni sistemi IPS BiH (official page) + Klix.ba coverage
signals.implies: ~20 BiH banks (incl. UniCredit BiH Mostar, UniCredit Banja Luka, NLB BiH x2, Nova banka, ASA Banka, Addiko x2, ProCredit, BBI, Union banka, Ziraat, MF banka, Privredna banka) still have to build ISO 20022 instant connectivity, 24/7 operations and real-time fraud monitoring. Printec: instant-payments/ISO 20022 integration, INETCO transaction monitoring, IMTF Siron AML re-tuned for 24/7 irrevocable payments, HSM/key management, managed 24/7 operations.
signals.likelihood: High - a defined queue of ~20 banks each needing the same integration inside 12-18 months
signals.followup: Monitor the CBBiH IPS BiH participant list monthly for each new joiner (each joiner = a live project); check FBA and ABRS for any mandated joining deadline.

signals.entity: RBI / Addiko Bank AG (Addiko BiH Sarajevo + Addiko Banja Luka, Addiko Montenegro)
signals.signal: RBI's voluntary public tender offer for Addiko closed on 29/07/2026 with acceptances for 10,831,435 shares = 56.16% of the Addiko shares subject to the offer, exceeding RBI's minimum threshold of >55% (which RBI had cut from >75% on 09/07/2026). NLB's rival all-cash offer at EUR37.00/share (threshold cut to 50%+1 share, approved by the Austrian Takeover Commission on 15/07/2026) lost on acceptances. RBI states this is not yet the formal Takeover-Act result publication. REVERSES the previous run's baseline, which had NLB ahead.
signals.source_name: RBI regulatory disclosure under the Austrian Takeover Act, via EQS News
signals.implies: RBI control of Addiko's two BiH banks and Addiko Montenegro triggers a multi-year integration: core/channel migration, ATM and POS estate consolidation and rebranding, card re-issue and re-personalisation, AML and transaction-monitoring platform consolidation onto RBI group standards. Printec already runs x-core multivendor ATM software at Raiffeisen Serbia and is NCR Atleos European Partner of the Year - a direct reference into the acquirer. Products: x-core, NCR Atleos ATMs/recyclers, TMS for the merged POS estate, card issuing/personalisation, IMTF Siron / INETCO, managed field services.
signals.likelihood: High - integration planning begins immediately; procurement inside 6-12 months subject to regulatory approvals
signals.followup: Watch addiko.com/takeover-offer/ and rbinternational.com publications-austrian-takeover-law for the formal Takeover-Act result; then track FBA/ABRS (BiH) and CBCG (ME) approvals and the Addiko integration/IT roadmap. Also watch whether NLB redirects its capital to another WB target.

signals.entity: Albanian banking sector / Bank of Albania
signals.signal: Card payments at POS overtook ATM cash withdrawals in number for the first time (full-year 2025), and the crossover has held for four consecutive quarters: 27.2m POS card payments in 2025 (+38.7% YoY, value ALL 105.75bn, +27%); Q1-2026 alone 7.58m POS card payments, +30% YoY; H1-2026 reported at ~12.57m POS card payments, +42% YoY. Two-thirds of bank transfers are now made through e-banking. Albanian banks went live on SEPA from October 2025; work on a national instant-payments system began in 2025 and Bank of Albania expects it to be finalised during 2026. Government target of a cashless economy by 2030; Bank of Albania is preparing a further intervention to cut card-acceptance commissions.
signals.source_name: Revista Monitor - 'Fillon SEPA, kanalet digjitale dominojne pagesat bankare' (analysis of Bank of Albania payment-system statistics)
signals.implies: Albania's acceptance estate has to grow fast while a regulator-driven fee cut squeezes acquirer margins - exactly the conditions that force banks to buy cheaper terminals, softPOS and a proper terminal-management system rather than hand-managing devices. Plus an instant-payments go-live expected inside 2026. Printec: Verifone/Castles POS + TMS, softPOS (phone-as-terminal), merchant onboarding/eKYC and e-signature (Namirial), instant-payments/ISO 20022 integration, INETCO monitoring; ATM side shifts from cash-out volume to deposit/recycling (NCR recyclers) and OptiCash optimisation.
signals.likelihood: High - the trend is measured and the regulator has pre-announced a further fee intervention
signals.followup: Pull the Bank of Albania payment-system statistics page (bankofalbania.org/Pagesat/Statistika_te_sistemeve_te_pagesave/) for the official H1-2026 series and the terminal/ATM counts; watch for the BoA regulation on card-acceptance commissions and for the instant-payments go-live announcement.
